name: Rex Moseley Fruit and Vegetable Farm
description: Rex Moseley Fruit and Vegetable Farm grows Apples, Pumpkins, and Honey in Warrens, WI. The farm is family-run, and its seasons run through autumn. The harvest is typically at its peak in autumn. Check the website or call ahead for current hours and what is in season.
Seasonal availability typically runs from Aug – Nov in this growing zone.
